Bill.BriefDescription: Reconvening an Alaskan Way viaduct and Seattle Seawall replacement project expert review panel.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reconvening the Alaskan Way viaduct and SeattleSeawall replacement project expert review panel; and adding a newsection to chapter 47.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall reconvene an expert review panel as described under RCW 47.01.400 for the purpose of updating the work that waspreviously completed by the panel on the Alaskan Way viaduct andSeattle Seawall replacement project and to ensure that an appropriateand viable financial plan is created and regularly reviewed. Theexpert review panel must be selected cooperatively by the chairs of thesenate and house of representatives transportation committees, thesecretary of transportation, the speaker of the house ofrepresentatives, the majority leader of the senate, and the governor.The expert review panel must report updated findings andrecommendations to the transportation commission, the transportationcommittees of the legislature, and the governor's Alaskan Way viaductprogram oversight committee by October 2011, and annually thereafter p. 1 SSB 5785until the project is operationally complete. Upon receipt of theexpert review panel's updated findings and recommendations, thegovernor must determine whether the financial plan for the Alaskan Wayviaduct and Seattle Seawall replacement project is feasible andsufficient to complete the project as described in the finalenvironmental impact statement. When reconvening the expert reviewpanel, the department must be attentive to cost and consider ways tominimize expert review panel expenditures, such as the use ofteleconferencing. Anticipated expenditures related to the expertreview panel must be included in the panel's findings andrecommendation reports.
